name: Spectrum Community Services Meals on Wheels
description: Spectrum Community Services delivers Meals on Wheels to homebound seniors in the Tri-Valley (Pleasanton, Livermore, Dublin, and Sunol), helping older adults stay safe, nourished, and independent at home.
fullDescription: Spectrum Community Services delivers Meals on Wheels to homebound seniors in the Tri-Valley (Pleasanton, Livermore, Dublin, and Sunol), helping older adults stay safe, nourished, and independent at home.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hot meals delivered Monday-Friday
- Frozen meals can be pre-ordered for weekends and holidays
- Heart-healthy, diabetic-friendly menus with dietitian oversight
- Friendly wellness check with each delivery
- Suggested contribution of $5 per meal, but no senior is refused
howToGetIt: You must be 60+, homebound, and unable to prepare your own meals. For Livermore, call 510-881-0304. For Dublin, Pleasanton, and Sunol, call 510-881-0305.
keywords: Spectrum Community Services, Meals on Wheels, Tri-Valley, Pleasanton, Livermore, Dublin, Sunol, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, nutrition
